where_it_stopped: the NON-SCIENTIFIC qualification/bootstrap turn, before any subject under study existed

observed_failure.error: MODEL_TRANSPORT_MODEL_TIMEOUT: ollama native cognition transport timed out after 120000ms
observed_failure.meaning: the production transport's frozen 120s bound was reached while the model had produced only ~132 tokens
observed_failure.sequence: the qualification turn's cognition call exceeded its bound, the turn failed closed, and the frozen bootstrap gate (R2_QUALIFICATION_FAILED) stopped the run at zero scientific turns

diagnosis.primary_cause: GPU VRAM exhaustion — the model no longer fits alongside the desktop's GPU consumers

measurements.quantity: throughput after a full unload/reload cycle
expected throughput for a 9.7B Q4_K_M model on this GPU class
GPU temperature / SM clock / max SM clock

diagnosis.arithmetic: 5.05 GiB model + 2.50 GiB desktop = 7.55 GiB against an 8.19 GiB device, leaving no headroom for the 8192-token KV cache and compute buffers. Every token therefore pages.
diagnosis.why_run_1_was_fine: when the server was started for run-1 it reported 6.9 GiB available — the desktop was holding roughly 1.1 GiB then. It now holds roughly 2.5 GiB. The experiment did not change; the machine did.
diagnosis.what_a_bounded_recovery_achieved: unloading and reloading the model improved throughput from 0.98 to 3.99 tok/s — real, but still roughly an order of magnitude short, and still far below what the frozen 120s transport bound requires for a 2048-token cognition budget

why_no_lawful_workaround_exists.why_rejected: it would edit the executor's transport configuration in response to an environment failure, and it would NOT fix the underlying paging — it would only make each degraded call slower
that is a change of executor configuration relative to run-1; the whole point of run-2 is to hold the executor fixed

why_no_lawful_workaround_exists.workaround: switch to a smaller model or a different provider
why_no_lawful_workaround_exists.why_rejected: explicitly forbidden — a provider swap would make run-2 a different experiment, and §10 requires that an identity change STOPs the run

why_no_lawful_workaround_exists.workaround: change the trajectory, events, or schedule
why_no_lawful_workaround_exists.why_rejected: explicitly forbidden, and irrelevant: the failure is in the provider, not the design

why_no_lawful_workaround_exists.workaround: free VRAM by terminating the desktop's GPU consumers
why_no_lawful_workaround_exists.why_rejected: those are the operator's own applications (Windows shell, Edge WebView, NVIDIA overlay); terminating them is an outward-facing state change on the user's machine, not a research action

the frozen 120s transport bound cannot accommodate the frozen 2048-token cognition budget at 4 tok/s, so the run would convert a resource shortage into spurious turn failures — a synthetic INCONCLUSIVE that would be indistinguishable in the record from a real one

precondition_to_resume.requirement: free VRAM such that the model plus its 8192-token KV cache fit alongside the desktop — approximately 6.5 GiB or more of the 8.19 GiB device free before the model loads
precondition_to_resume.how_to_verify: start the server, confirm the startup line reports an available figure near the 6.9 GiB run-1 had, then measure a short generation and require tens of tokens per second before submitting any scientific turn
what_must_NOT_change_when_resuming: the model identity (qwen3.5:9b) and the provider (production Ollama)
the transport configuration, including num_ctx and the 120s bound
the frozen trajectory, valence table, turn count, scorer, predicate and invalid policy
the fresh-subject requirement: run-2's subjects have no state and must be reused as-is, or replaced by new fresh subjects if the app itself is restarted

what_this_does_not_mean: it is NOT a scientific null — no scientific turn was ever executed
it does NOT change HISTORY_INTERNALIZATION_V1_INCONCLUSIVE for run-1
it does NOT weaken the remediation: the host-layer recovery remains complete and verified
it does NOT authorise Phase 1, and it does NOT authorise changing the design

run2_state_assessment.denominator_contamination: none — there is no scientific data to contaminate
run2_state_assessment.reusable: the run-2 directory is a clean, empty scientific slate; the failed bootstrap may be re-attempted once the precondition is met, because no scientific turn and no subject state exists
run2_state_assessment.must_be_declared_on_resume: the failure class, the diagnosis and the recovery measurements recorded here
